name: quotation-manager
description: Order-to-dispatch document management — deploy entry point. Local development still runs the two halves separately (see start-app.bat).

scripts.build: npm --prefix client ci --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server ci --omit=dev
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server exec tsc -- --noEmit && npm --prefix client exec tsc -- --noEmit
